name: Instrument: Build the reset's seat load reading (gated on `86ajgn2z5`)
text_content:
I5, extending S8's variety test record (86akhcz49) and S4's bandwidth ledger. The form of the reset's first read, the Maitre d's seat, and of the same read for every lead seat: the nine inputs with their sources, the arithmetic of check-ins held against windows worked, one line per mode for the seat, the carrier chosen among designation, stack, and procedure as a versioned change, and the refused carriers listed so the reset cannot reach for them. Runs for the Head of Beverage's and the chef seat's loads as well; converts the mentor pool at the first reset. Refuses a second seat, a floor manager under any name, an assistant of any title, a count from memory, a founder's impression as an input, and a benchmark span. Lives on the reset's record on the partners' page; the partners with the leads, at every reset. High. Gated on 86ajgn2z5 and, for the seat holder's own line, 86akhb2jg.

Filed by Session 9 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmj07. Reasoning lives on the S9 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.

comment.text: Session 13 adds three counts to the reset's first read of the Maitre d's seat and no new read: reviews held, moved, and extended per lead per period, beside Session 12's placed, extended, and moved check-in counts, because the Maitre d holds every floor review on the same windows. The permitted carriers are the stack (placing reviews at closed hours and across the seat's windows, with the person's own clock spreading them through the year) and the procedure; the refused carriers stay refused, a designation cannot carry it because a designation holds no review, and the review is never thinned, delegated to a mentor or a senior server, or moved onto a review season to fit. S13 page, section 8.4; P19; readiness row 165.

comment.text: Session 12 adds three counts to the reset's first read of the Maitre d's seat and no new read: placed check-ins, check-ins extended past fifteen minutes, and moved check-ins, per month. For the coaching load specifically only two of the three permitted carriers apply, the stack (placement across the seat's windows, the interval as a parameter) and the procedure (the fifteen minutes, one hypothesis per check-in, the pre-read from records), because a designation holds no check-in; the refused carriers stay refused, no lead's coaching is delegated to a mentor, and the check-in is never thinned to fit. The baseline for the three counts is team-filled from dinner's first quarter at the first house review, and the placed-check-in parameter is set from it at the first reset. S12 page, section 12; P37, P49; readiness row 150.
